 Follow Joe Manganiello On Steelers Fandom & His Fight For Survival | In Motion With Ashley Nicole Moss
 Complex Wed, October 28, 2026 at 11:00 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Actor, Director and Writer Joe Manganiello joins host Ashley Nicole Moss for another episode of Complex Bets Presents: In Motion to talk about being a Pittsburgh Steelers superfan, his thoughts on Aaron Rodgers' Super Bowl chances this year, why the city of Pittsburgh is so star-studded and goes in-depth about his new book, "Bloodlines", including his harrowing fight for survival against an autoimmune disease.
